content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4: the only plan that reaches the 80% target, at 83.1% service level from 12:00-14:45 for ₹14,268 extra.","why":"Payments calls hit 212 against 100 forecast at 11:45 and service level fell to 4.7%. The extra calls are mostly payment status and refund status enquiries, which matches incident INC-20261112-1271 (IMPS/NEFT transfers stuck pending after debit). With no action, the window is predicted at 33.1% with 24.6% abandons. P4 combines an IVR outage message, 20% chat deflection, callback, delayed breaks on both queues and overtime for payments agents (40 agents 12:30-13:30, then 25 agents 13:30-14:30). It is predicted to deliver 86.1% on payments and 77.8% on general, with abandons down to 4.2% and 90.8% for the rest of the day. It has no policy violations.","trade_offs":["P3 costs ₹8,640, saving ₹5,628, but reaches only 67.4% (payments 64.6%) with 8.5% abandons, short of target.","P2 costs ₹1,668 and gives 50.5% with 12.9% abandons. That is much cheaper, but leaves payments customers at 44.2%.","P1 costs nothing but performs worse than doing nothing (29.6%). Its general-queue break delays drop general to 53.8%.","P4 also delays general breaks. General stays at 77.8%, slightly below 80%, and above general's 62.2% with no action."],"watch":"P4 depends on overtime uptake (65 agent-slots in total). If fewer agents accept, expect results closer to P3. Also track the incident status: if INC-20261112-1271 runs past 14:00, the IVR message and chat deflection end before the window closes at 14:45 and will need extending. Check that general-queue service level holds near 78% while its breaks are delayed."}
